verdict.rationale: Superpowers offers only an indirect analog to a sandbox. It automatically creates a git worktree after brainstorming so parallel work doesn't clobber the source branch, and work merges back only on request. Destructive or irreversible actions stop for human approval, and worktree removal refuses to force-delete uncommitted work. This isolates code changes but is not a sandbox test environment separated from production data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test environment, production-data isolation, and any hands-on corroboration.
